regions.text: 那岐伊邪那美の二神が一次は右より趣か楽ペ我は左より郷か逢出む』と云って「天の御柱を行き逃り逢つた」と

quote.translation: Consider the legend in the Kojiki in which the two gods Izanagi and Izanami, saying "You go round from the right and meet me, I will go round from the left and meet you", "went round the heavenly pillar and met".

regions.text: ふ古事犯の傳説も印度の昔から行はれた僕式であると否とは別間題として極めて象徴性に富んだ原始的事件である。

quote.translation: Whether or not this was a rite performed since ancient times in India is a separate question; it is a primitive event extremely rich in symbolism.

regions.text: 源氏を空蟬も遂坂の開で「わくらばに初き激ぷ」たのである。

quote.translation: Genji and Utsusemi, too, "met by chance" (wakuraba ni yuki-au) at the Ōsaka barrier.

regions.text: 「私はKに向つて御娘さんと一所に出たのかと聞きました。

quote.translation: Or again: "I asked K whether he had gone out together with the young lady.
K answered that it was not so.

regions.text: Kはさうではないと答へました。真砂町で偶然出卿つたから遂れ立つて締つて来たのだと競明しました『愛日減石、ころ）。

quote.translation: He explained that he had met them by chance at Masago-chō and so they had come back together" (Natsume Sōseki, Kokoro).

regions.text: 要するに假説積極偶然の一般性格として、また度くは一般に偶然そのものの性格をして衝むなか一元の通過といふ意味構造が目撃されるのである。

quote.translation: In short, as the general character of positive hypothetical contingency, and more broadly as the character of the contingent itself in general, we witness the meaning structure of the Encounter of two independent elements.

regions.text: 周易の指導原理も遯逅としての偶然にある。陰腸二元論

quote.translation: The guiding principle of the Book of Changes (Zhouyi) also lies in the contingent as Encounter (邂逅).

regions.text: 他くまでもその本質であり甲の爻と乙の爻との期せざる避遍が男全體の芸礎である。

quote.translation: The dualism of yin and yang is its essence throughout, and the unexpected Encounter of line A with line B is the foundation of the entire Changes.
The line (爻) means crossing (交), that is, it means nothing other than Encounter.
